## Proyecto Aprendizaje de Máquina - Hoteles Kaggle

```{r}
sample_submission = read.csv("Datos/sample_submission.csv")
```


Proyecto


```{r}
hoteles = read.csv("Datos/entrena.csv") |>
  mutate(hotel = factor(hotel),
         arrival_date_month = factor(arrival_date_month),
         meal = factor(meal),
         country = factor(country),
         market_segment = factor(market_segment),
         distribution_channel = factor(distribution_channel),
         reserved_room_type = factor(reserved_room_type),
         assigned_room_type = factor(assigned_room_type),
         deposit_type = factor(deposit_type),
         agent = factor(agent),
         company = factor(company),
         customer_type = factor(customer_type),
         )

### Drop nulls for now
hoteles = hoteles[complete.cases(hoteles), ]

hoteles = hoteles |> sample_n(size = 1000)

hoteles = hoteles |> select(-c(agent, company))
# 
# hoteles |> summary()
# 
# hoteles |> select( distribution_channel )
```



```{r}
hoteles_split = initial_split(hoteles, strata = is_canceled, prop = 0.9)
hoteles_entrena <- training(hoteles_split)

hoteles_split
```

```{r}
nrow(hoteles_entrena)
hoteles |> count(is_canceled) |> 
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |> 
  mutate(pct = round(pct, 2))
```

```{r}
# preparacion de datos
hoteles_receta <- recipe(is_canceled ~ . , hoteles_entrena) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal(), -is_canceled) |>
  step_relevel(is_canceled,  ref_level = "cancelado", skip = TRUE) 
hoteles_receta_norm <- hoteles_receta |> 
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
# modelos
modelo_logistico <- 
  logistic_reg(mixture = 0.5, penalty = 0.01) |> 
  set_args(lambda.min_ratio = 1e-18) |> 
  set_engine("glmnet") |> 
  set_mode("classification")
# modelo_kvmc <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = 20) |> 
#   set_mode("classification")
```


```{r}
conjunto_wfs <- workflow_set(
  preproc = list(receta_base = hoteles_receta, 
                 receta_norm = hoteles_receta_norm),
  models = list(reg_logistica = modelo_logistico
                #, k_vecinos = modelo_kvmc,
                ),
  cross = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
val_split = manual_rset(hoteles_split |> list(), "val")
mis_metricas <- metric_set(mn_log_loss, accuracy)
resultados <- conjunto_wfs |> 
  workflow_map("fit_resamples", resamples = val_split, 
               metrics = mis_metricas)
resultados |> select(wflow_id, result) |> 
  unnest(result) |> unnest(.metrics)
```
